name: Zanda BizzyAI
description: Zanda BizzyAI is the AI scribe for Zanda (formerly Power Diary), an Australian-founded practice management platform popular with allied health practitioners. Key differentiator: pay-per-use pricing at $1/hour of transcription—no monthly commitment required. BizzyAI transcribes sessions and generates notes in your personal writing style. Base Zanda plans start at $19/month (Starter), making it one of the most affordable all-in-one options. ISO 27001 certified and HIPAA compliant with no data used for AI training. BizzyAI: Insights (AI-driven reports and clinical data queries) coming soon. Best for allied health and therapy practitioners already on Zanda or in Australia/UK markets.

faqs.q: How much does Zanda BizzyAI cost in 2026?
faqs.a: BizzyAI: Scribe costs $1/hour of transcription—pay-per-use with no monthly commitment. Base Zanda plans start at $19/month (Starter). For a therapist doing 20 one-hour sessions/month: ~$39/month total ($19 base + $20 transcription).

faqs.q: What is Zanda's pay-per-use AI pricing model?
faqs.a: Unlike monthly subscription AI scribes, BizzyAI charges $1/hour of session transcription. You only pay for what you use—ideal for part-time practitioners or those with variable session volumes. No commitment required.
Yes. Zanda BizzyAI is HIPAA compliant with BAA available and ISO 27001 certified. No data is used to train AI models, and all information is processed securely in real-time.

faqs.q: Can I use BizzyAI without Zanda?
faqs.a: No. BizzyAI is native to Zanda (formerly Power Diary). If you don't use Zanda, consider standalone options like Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo) that work with any EHR.

faqs.q: Zanda BizzyAI vs monthly subscription AI scribes: which is better?
faqs.a: It depends on volume. At $1/hour, BizzyAI is cheaper for low-volume practitioners (under 30 hours/month). High-volume practitioners (40+ sessions/month) may find unlimited monthly plans like Mentalyc more cost-effective.
